message: FSRS orientation is ready. Well supported: how the model works and that it out-predicts HLR. Not yet supported by data in hand: that it beats SM-2 — next run looks for a head-to-head comparison.

Revised: FSRS does beat SM-2 on recall prediction in the developers' benchmark (log loss 0.346 vs 0.616 for Anki's SM-2, which even loses to a constant guess). Still unproven: that this saves reviews for real learners.
Your question about log-loss gaps is answered: in calibration terms FSRS-6 is off by ~6.5 points vs ~17 for Anki's SM-2. See 'How schedulers are compared' → Another way to see it.
Two research runs in a row on “Modern spaced-repetition scheduling (FSRS)” added nothing new. Consider pausing it (`kw topic pause fsrs`) or changing its questions.
